note: CityMap.load() in full, citymap.js:476-931: the exact stage ORDER and progress text, reproduced as RunCritical (cityData -> roadNet -> river -> tunnelGround -> tunnelCuts -> terrainMesh -> buildingCatalogs -> buildings -> spawn -> roads -> junctions -> bridgeSpans -> realBridges -> tunnels -> water -> riverSheet -> ready, citymap.js:480-889) then RunScenery, one stage per yielded frame (trees/rocks/grass/streetlights/road signs/worship/landmarks/parks/metro/airport/plane hall/malls/infrastructure/shopfronts, citymap.js:895-927, the JS's own array literal, cross-checked byte for byte against the source text by tools/_probe_cityload.py rather than retyped a second time with no proof). Every stage calls an existing builder's own verified entry point (RoadBuilder.LoadRoadNet/MergeRoadNet/BuildRoadDeck/BuildJunctions, BridgeBuilder.RealBridgeZones/BuildSpans/BuildRealBridges, TunnelCuts.BuildingIndex.Build/TunnelCuts.Build, TunnelBuilder.Build, TerrainBuilder.Build, BuildingFacts/BuildingKit.Catalog/BuildingParts/WallMaterials.Catalog.Load, BuildingBuilder.BuildRich, WaterBodies.Build, RiverSheet.Build, GrassCover.Build, WorshipPlacer.Build, ParkBuilder.Build, MetroBuilder.Build, MallPlacer.Build, LandmarkPlacer.PlaceWorld/BuildProcedural/PlaceStreetStatues/PlaceBusts, AirportBuilder.Load+Place*/Build*/Get31LSpawn, InfraBuilder.Build*, ShopfrontBuilder.Build) and records the REAL call order into Context.StageOrder, a List<string> a probe reads back rather than trusting this file's own constants. Also drives FacadeProps.BuildFacadeProps across every non-kit-claimed footprint (BuildFacadePropsForEveryBuilding) since BuildingBuilder.cs — off limits to edit per the port brief's hard rules — never calls it. NOT PORTED: the road-snapping half of _computeSpawn (citymap.js's own _computeSpawn is not in this port's file list; CityLoader's 'spawn' stage only reproduces the exact-spawnLatLon branch, falling back to the city origin); trees/rocks/streetlights/road signs/plane hall/groves have no Unity builder anywhere in City/ yet (named, empty stages — CityLoader.UnportedStages lists them explicitly, matching GameLoop.cs's own 'WHAT IS STUBBED' honesty pattern, not silently skipped); the RiverSheet carve data is built once (in the 'river' stage, ahead of TerrainBuilder, matching where the JS's own carve-dependency runs) rather than twice at the JS's own two call sites, which changes WHEN the mesh exists but not what it contains; BuildFacadePropsForEveryBuilding approximates cx/cz as a plain vertex-average centroid (not BuildRich's likely area-weighted one) and the roof pitched-roof flag as always false (that flag is resolved inside BuildingBuilder.BuildRich's private per-building loop, not exposed) — both documented as over-placement, not under-placement, in the method's own doc comment.

The half of the per-building relief loop FacadeRelief.cs's own class doc explicitly left out: AC units (citymap.js:5157-5166, the i===0 street-wall branch only — the pb/photo-facade AC branch at 5192-5205 is the photo-facade agent's exclusive system, not ported here, matching FacadeRelief.cs's own stated exclusion), downpipes (citymap.js:5117-5135), entrance canopies (citymap.js:5136-5155, including the ent_old/entrance variant choice), satellite dishes beside a balcony (citymap.js:5046-5057), flat-roof parapets (citymap.js:5356-5375) and roof clutter — roof_box/roof_tank/roof_vent/the roof AC cluster (citymap.js:5376-5407). Also carries the box-fallback + cull-distance/chunk-size RenderSpec data for these six kinds, transcribed from _buildFacadeProps' own put(...) call sites (citymap.js:6161-6211) — geometry name, fallback THREE.BoxGeometry dimensions/offset/colour, maxDist, chunkM, lodable — as pure data for whatever instancing layer resolves them against the Blender facade_kit.fbx pieces, the same boundary FacadeRelief.cs draws for its own six item kinds. Every budget cap (AcBudget=50000, DishBudget=30000, DrainBudget=80000, EntranceBudget=60000, ParapetBudget=70000, RoofPropBudget=50000) matches citymap.js's own `.length < N` push-site guards, cross-checked against the live source text by tools/_probe_cityload.py. NOT PORTED: the pb/photo-facade AC+window relief branch (citymap.js:5168-5205, out of scope per FacadeRelief.cs's own documented boundary); the ground-slope burial check's exact heightAt call is reproduced in the Unity file but NOT in the Python cross-check probe (which has no TerrainSampler), so the Python-side counts in tools/_probe_cityload.py are a slight OVER-count versus the real in-engine ones — documented in that script's own printed NOTE line, not silent.

_placeChunkedInstanced in full, citymap.js:7940-8041, minus the actual THREE.InstancedMesh construction: buckets items into chunkM-sized XZ cells (citymap.js:7958's own `floor(x/chunkM)_floor(z/chunkM)` key), builds one Matrix4x4[] per cell via a caller-supplied delegate, and returns the per-cell culling record (Cx/Cz/MaxDist/LodD2/Cy/ShadowD2/CastShadow — a field-for-field mirror of the JS `rec` pushed to chunkMeshes at citymap.js:7987, with SHADOW_DIST=500 citymap.js:257 baked in). PURE DATA per the port's hard rule (no GameObject, no Mesh, no InstancedMesh) — CityRenderer.cs or whatever system ends up issuing Graphics.RenderMeshInstanced per visible chunk is the rendering half this file deliberately stops short of, the same split FacadeRelief.cs draws for its own item lists. NOT PORTED: the stack-capture-based `layer` attribution tag (citymap.js:7953-7955, a debug/profiling aid with no bearing on visuals or culling correctness) and the per-instance computeBoundingSphere a real InstancedMesh gets for free (this file pads its Bounds by a flat margin instead, documented in Place()'s own doc comment, since there is no real mesh here to measure).

_cullDue in full (citymap.js:1117-1128) plus the chunk-attach half of update(camPos, dt) (citymap.js:1144-1215): the camera-moved gate (teleport >500 m forces a full unsliced sweep, <2 m skips entirely), the CULL_SLICES=4 round-robin slice (citymap.js:251), and the per-chunk Hi/Lo/Shadow distance tests (altitude-scaled default radius 3500+alt*3 unless a layer's own MaxDist overrides it, the true-3D LOD switch, the independent shadow cutoff). Exposed as CityCulling.Tick(Vector3, float) — matching GameLoop.WorldTick's own `Action<Vector3, float>` field (Core/GameLoop.cs:198) exactly, so wiring it in is a one-line assignment for whoever owns GameLoop's scene wiring; `dt` itself is read by nothing in this file (the JS chunk-cull section doesn't read it either). Also CollapseAnim.Step / CollapseState / CollapseFrame: _updateCollapses' pure kinematics (citymap.js:2409-2457) for both the inst/landmark squash+tilt+wobble branch and the ordinary building-shell buckle+dark+lean branch. Distance math in Tick/CullDue accumulates in DOUBLE over the camera/chunk-centre coordinates — this coordinate frame spans six cities (|x| up to ~264 km), the same frame whose float32 shoelace-area sum another agent just found silently mis-sizing 25% of all building footprints; squaring/summing two such large-coordinate differences in float32 can round a result by metres at the far edge of the frame, and double removes that margin for the price of two casts per chunk per frame. NOT PORTED: the dust/smoke/secondary-blast FX _updateCollapses spawns alongside the kinematics (citymap.js:2423-2440, 2462-2494 fx.spawnSmoke/fx.explosion/onBlast/_launchDebris) — no FX system is ported in this slice, left as the eventual caller's job once one exists, same precedent as GameLoop.cs's own stubbed hooks; the water-shader time update and shopSigns/planeHall per-frame calls also inside update() (citymap.js:1131-1143) have no bearing on chunk visibility and are out of this file's named scope.
